evals.prompt: Run the full cycle for the next task. I'm on a Node/TypeScript project using bun and jest. The next cc:TODO in plans/phase-4.md is to add a rate-limiter middleware.
evals.expected_output: Claude marks the task cc:WIP, runs the TDD loop (write failing test → implement → refactor → gate), then runs a structured review (Security/Performance/Quality), and on APPROVE marks the task cc:done and commits.

assertions.text: Task is marked cc:WIP before any implementation, and the TDD loop (Red → Green → Refactor → Gate) is followed
A structured review (Security, Performance, Quality) is run after the gate passes, not before
On APPROVE outcome, task is marked cc:done and a commit is offered or made
A cycle summary is printed showing TDD, Review outcome, and AC verification
The full loop completes without requiring the user to manually invoke harness-review

evals.prompt: harness-cycle — the next task in plans/phase-2.md is to add JWT authentication to the login route. After the TDD loop, the review finds that the token is logged at INFO level, exposing it in logs.
evals.expected_output: Claude completes the TDD loop, runs the review, finds the credential exposure as IMPORTANT, outputs REQUEST_CHANGES, fixes the logging, re-runs the gate (passes), re-reviews (no findings), then marks cc:done and commits.

assertions.text: Review produces REQUEST_CHANGES when a CRITICAL or IMPORTANT finding is present
After REQUEST_CHANGES, the finding is fixed and the review is re-run before committing
Lint and tests are re-run after the fix to confirm the gate still passes
On APPROVE outcome, task is marked cc:done and a commit is offered or made
A cycle summary is printed showing TDD, Review outcome, and AC verification
